svg.title: The seawall walkway nearest the viewer on a Pacific afternoon: scored concrete panels with a dashed yellow lane line, a granite curb, and a planting bed below it of sword ferns and salal with a few river rocks. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no balustrade, lamp, sign or figure.
